name: rankbolt
description: Write, optimize and publish SEO blog articles with RankBolt.

interface.longDescription:
RankBolt writes, optimizes and publishes SEO blog articles for your website, and this plugin brings that workflow into ChatGPT.

Sign in with your RankBolt account and ask ChatGPT to:
- List, read, search and fetch the articles of any of your sites.
- Draft new SEO-optimized articles from a brief, grounded in your site's audience, keywords and existing content.
- Edit titles, content, slugs and SEO metadata, humanize AI-sounding drafts, or reformulate a paragraph.
- Schedule or publish articles; scheduled articles are pushed automatically to your connected CMS (WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Wix or Notion).
- Organize content with tags and manage the media library, including AI-generated featured images.

Every tool is scoped to your sites: with one site it is selected automatically, with several ChatGPT asks which one to use. Destructive actions such as deleting an article are clearly marked so ChatGPT confirms with you first.

RankBolt is the hosted platform behind the plugin; the plugin exposes the same capabilities as the RankBolt dashboard, CLI and MCP server at https://rankbolt.ai/mcp.
capabilities: List and search your blog articles
Read the full text of an article
Draft SEO-optimized articles from a brief
Generate SEO titles and meta descriptions
Schedule and publish to your CMS
Manage tags and the media library
defaultPrompt: List my RankBolt articles and tell me which drafts still have no featured image.
Draft an SEO article about AI search for Shopify stores and schedule it for next Monday.
Audit the meta titles and descriptions of my last five published posts and fix the weak ones.

positive.description: Identify the signed-in account and its sites
positive.prompt: Who am I on RankBolt and which sites do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the signed-in user's name and email and lists the account's sites with their ids. No other tool is called.

positive.description: List articles and spot drafts without a featured image
positive.prompt: List my RankBolt articles and tell me which drafts still have no featured image.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a table of the site's articles with status; drafts whose featured_image is empty are called out explicitly.

positive.prompt: What did I write about AI search? Summarize the most relevant article.
positive.expected_behavior: search returns matching articles as citations (id, title, url); fetch returns the full Markdown of the chosen one and the answer summarizes it with the article URL.

positive.description: Generate and save SEO metadata for an existing article
positive.prompt: Write a better meta title and meta description for my article 'Best AI Tools for Blog Writing in 2026' and save them.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes a meta title and description, asks for confirmation, then update_article stores them; the reply shows the saved values.

positive.description: Draft an article and schedule it
positive.prompt: Draft one SEO article about 'AI search for Shopify stores' and schedule it for next Monday at 9:00.
positive.expected_behavior: generate_articles creates a draft (30-90 s); update_article sets status 'scheduled' with an ISO scheduled_at for next Monday 09:00; the reply states the title and the scheduled time.

negative.description: Unrelated request must not trigger RankBolt
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Bulk destructive request must not be executed without explicit confirmation
Plan changes are not handled by the plugin
negative.prompt: Upgrade my RankBolt plan to Agency.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin never shows plans, prices, checkout or upgrade flows. Plan-related errors only link to the informational pricing section of rankbolt.ai.

publication.release_notes: Initial listing. Sign in with a RankBolt account to list, search and read your blog articles, draft SEO-optimized articles from a brief, generate SEO metadata and featured images, humanize or reformulate text, manage tags and media, and schedule or publish to your connected CMS.
